dialogues.speaker: Cappet
dialogues.text: #Well, if it isn't the Marquis of Carabas, along with {M#his}{F#her} cat and little fairy?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: #Umm, I think we should probably stop this now. Surely it's time that {NICKNAME} and I dropped these roles?

dialogues.speaker: Boborano
dialogues.text: In theory, it should all be over now. But I remember hearing that the point of the ceremony was to help people transition from one mental state to another.

dialogues.speaker: Boborano
dialogues.text: To bid farewell to the title of Marquis of Carabas once and for all, you can bring things to a close with a touch of formality.

dialogues.speaker: Albizzi
dialogues.text: "As the Nekomata bids farewell to her boots, through the reflection are we wiser to the nature of the truth."
